calculation.description: For each tradable asset, regress daily returns on the equal-weight cross-asset benchmark over a 60-day rolling window; compute residual returns, sum residual returns over 20 days, and divide by 40-day residual volatility annualized to a 20-day scale. Higher values indicate persistent risk-adjusted idiosyncratic strength relative to the available 15-asset universe.

metrics.ic_definition: daily Spearman cross-sectional IC versus 10-trading-day forward returns; negative sign is predictive and may be inverted by portfolio construction

validation.regime_notes: Updated 10-day IC means: 2026 -0.161928, 2027 +0.055845, 2028 -0.017889, 2029 -0.061744, 2030 -0.084443, 2031 -0.029312, 2032 through 2032-06-09 -0.013464. Overall negative association remains above absolute IC and ICIR gates, but 2027 sign instability warrants conservative use and inverse direction verification.
